newsitem.title: UK: BFI up six, Atlantic Panamxaes still firming.
newsitem.headline: BFI up six, Atlantic Panamxaes still firming.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up six to 1,367 points.

Brokers said Atlantic Panamax rates continued to appreciate with Chariot 68,400 dwt fixed by Frapaco delivery Gibraltar July 20 trip via US Gulf with grain to Japan at $13,000 daily and Delphic Pride 64,096 dwt confirmed by NSS delivery North Spain prompt trip via US Gulf with coal to Japan at $14,000 daily.
Dreyfus were reported to have fixed Evdoxos for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan for July 16/25 at $24.50 no combo (although some reports put the rates at $24.25).
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was two points lower to 15 points higher in the traded positions and turnover was 78 lots.
